item.description:
Location: Singapore
Description:

Immediate opportunities exist for various ranks on a modern LNG bunkering vessel operating in Singapore. Positions include Master, Chief Officer, 2nd/3rd Officer, Able Seafarer Deck/Navigational Watch Rating, OS, Chief Engineer, 2nd/3rd Engineer (EOOW), Oiler/Wiper, and Ship’s Cook. Officers typically work 10 weeks on/off, extendable to 3 months, while ratings have 4-6 months onboard followed by 2 months’ leave. Valid MPA-issued/endorsed certificates, STCW/LNG qualifications, and relevant medical reports are required. LNG experience is preferred. Joining is ASAP.



Apply to this job
